question: Does an improvement developed on AuditLab material help an API auditor solve NEW financial cases without more false accusations? A positive result is not assumed.

arms.C: A + AuditLab-derived designated-payment procedure and one worked train example

held_equal.limits: genesis-official-60s: 60 s from reset incl. API latency, 100 actions
held_equal.context_budget: B and C additions within 10% characters (test); token use measured per call

B.provenance: written from general audit practice; no AuditLab failure, trajectory or truth was consulted

observed_weakness: live Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite pilot, dev family 922101: empty submission on a partial allocation of 3 024 000 minor KZT (one completed attempt; docs/research/gemini)
GPT Pro 1 local curriculum (docs/research/financial-curriculum): the random policy missed a payment_allocation 3/3 before and after reduction on a train family
provenance.rule_source: public policy.allocation text and settlement_index field of the public payments table
provenance.worked_example: datasets/open/train/E39A14EA0FB98F9BC3E42C3738182D142 (train split): public records only; its truth was read only to confirm the example's amount (2000 USD)
provenance.not_used: dev family 922101 values, any holdout, any final family

tuning.status: no live dev tuning was possible before freeze (no provider key in this environment); prompts are first versions frozen here

final.episodes: Claude Pro 2 sealed holdout (agent-generalization-1.1), via the integrator

metrics.primary: mean official return per family (family = mean over its clean and error variants and repetitions), paired differences B-A, C-A, C-B with Claude Pro 2's cluster bootstrap (10000, seed 20261121) and sign-flip test
secondary: clean attempts with a false accusation
finding labels: wrong amount / currency / entities / evidence
metrics.service: rate_limited, quota_exhausted, provider_error, bridge_failure, interrupted, budget_stop are reported with their counts and never counted as model misses or FPs; Claude Pro 2's official-rule scoring of every attempt is reported separately

decision.improvement_shown_only_if: the 95% interval of the primary difference excludes 0 AND the clean-accusation rate does not increase beyond its interval

replication.criterion: the miss is called repeatable only if >= 2 of 3 COMPLETED attempts on each error condition miss it; denominators include unfinished attempts
